range_definition: Observed range of independent parent means, not confidence intervals
unit_definition: Each parent averages its available heldout folds; folds are repeated measurements
accuracy_definition: Accuracy and its coverage use the same nonempty accepted-known folds within each parent
unfamiliar_definition: Parent mean of per-fold maximum heldout/near/far acceptance
target_note: Lines show individual target components; parent success requires three of four folds to meet all criteria
training_note: Original four-group panel64/256 becomes known training48/192; no unfamiliar training examples
